desc: Produce a compact, self-contained Python implementation of generateString using the KMP automaton backward feasibility DP (or a simpler equivalent) that fits within token limits.
Run the current implementation against the three sample tests and report an explicit PASS/FAIL verdict.

Run additional small random brute-force validation against a naive checker for small n and m, including edge cases (m=1, all T, all F, overlapping T conflicts, F windows forced equal by T constraints, repeated-character str2, multiple F windows sharing one free position), and report an explicit PASS/FAIL verdict with failing input if any.
If any test fails, either fix the failing case or switch to a different approach.
